pyramiding_rule: Zero pyramiding into retracements; only scale into positions when momentum velocity exceeds 2 standard deviations and existing inventory is trailing-stopped in profit.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Enforce a 15-second volatility buffer and require order flow imbalance to exceed +65% in the direction of the trade before execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% at +$10.00 profit, lock breakeven + commission, and let the remaining half run freely toward the $25-$30 asymmetric target.
